g.text: Rails VBUS (Connector -> Power and Controller; the single 5 V input, decision 14), 3V3, 3V3_D are sheet pins; +5V is internal to Power (U5 TPS259631 eFuse OUT); GND is global. HV_ nets and APD_BIAS are net class HV (1.0 mm clearance).

g.text: LVDS_P is low for a logic one (post-amp non-inverting after an OPA857 whose OUT swings down with light); the FPGA inverts.
